candidates.cover_letter:
To Whom it May Concern:

I am excited to apply for the Adolescent Services Manager position with AWA. With more than 15 years of experience working with adolescents, leading interdisciplinary teams, coordinating programs, and partnering with families, I believe my background in education translates directly to the structure, leadership, and relationship-building required in this role.

Throughout my career as a middle school educator, I have been responsible for creating safe, structured environments where adolescents with different needs, personalities, and challenges could succeed. I regularly worked with students experiencing academic, behavioral, and interpersonal difficulties and collaborated with families, counselors, administrators, and colleagues to address concerns and develop effective solutions. My experience has taught me how important consistency, clear expectations, appropriate boundaries, and strong relationships are when working with adolescents.

In my role as an Academic Team Leader, I led an interdisciplinary team of educators across multiple subject areas, facilitated meetings, coordinated responsibilities, mentored colleagues, and served as a liaison between staff and administration. I also served as a primary point of contact for parents, including during sensitive situations requiring thoughtful communication and problem-solving. These experiences have prepared me to provide clear expectations, support staff, and help maintain consistent program operations.

My experience also extends beyond the classroom. As a coach of three middle school athletic programs, I provided structure, mentorship, accountability, and behavioral guidance while communicating directly with families. As the coordinator of a large Washington, D.C. student trip, I managed schedules, logistics, multiple stakeholders, changing circumstances, and unexpected problems while maintaining a safe and organized experience for students.

I was also nominated for the 2024–25 District Teacher of the Year Award, recognition that reflects the relationships I built with students, families, and colleagues and the leadership I brought to my school community.

I am particularly interested in this opportunity because it would allow me to apply the leadership and adolescent-support skills I have developed throughout my career in a mental health setting. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to AWA's work with adolescents and families while continuing to grow as a program leader.

Thank you for your consideration. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my experience could contribute to your adolescent services team.

Sincerely,
Timothy Baker
